features.title: Catch Up on Join
features.verification_note: Signed room-bound records bind original author, random 128-bit identity, claimed sender time and bounded UTF-8 text. Native workers reverify original signatures during storage, snapshot parsing and delivery; C# structurally parses trusted native events rather than independently verifying arbitrary input. Identical text with different signatures is retained. Receipt-time retention is 24 hours, 256 records per room and 8,192 globally; duplicates do not renew receipts. Automatic catch-up uses signed nonce/attempt requests, addressed/provider-bound offers, four fetch/serve slots, authenticated bounded Bao downloads, memory-only snapshots, 32 cached snapshots and 60-second leases. Clear cancels delayed fetches under the store lock. Optional C ABI exports and events 34/35/36 carry exact live/history records and successful local-clear acknowledgement. Dedicated per-active-handle delivery retains 256 distinct pending originals and one clear acknowledgement, coalesces duplicates, alternates with general events and drains channels round-robin. Excess pending records evict the oldest with a drop count. Clear removes older pending lines, blocked authors are purged without an enqueue race, block/unblock invalidates cached offer views, and late metadata cannot recreate left/closed handles. Polling performs no SQL or cryptography. The configurable UI loads backlog without unread counts, live notifications or pull replay; full signatures deduplicate, raw claimed times are preserved, and tooltips show original node identity/time caveats. All 102 default and 113 optional workspace tests pass (native/channel-history-delivery-privacy-workspace-tests.log), including real two-channel/512-record pressure with a 16-slot general queue, active-handle lifetime and actual blocking/unblocking/cache invalidation. Optimized Windows/Linux libraries are in native/channel-history-delivery/ (channel-history-delivery-optimized-build.log). All ten actual optimized C# binding tests pass, including author-offline late join/rejoin, clear, original bytes and a 256-record public-API pressure case with zero historical unread count (channel-history-delivery-optimized-managed-pressure-tests.log). Actual archived legacy/new optimized libraries preserve friend/presence/room text and clean repeated signed text interoperability (channel-history-delivery-optimized-mixed-version-tests.log). Expanded Windows ABI smoke passes under isolated Fedora 44 Wine, checking direct reachability, signed live metadata, byte-exact saved originals and acknowledged clear (channel-history-delivery-wine-smoke.log); prefix refresh failure is recorded separately before the actual executable gate. Managed Core passes 85 tests; plugin Release build has zero warnings/errors (channel-history-delivery-plugin-build.log). Refreshed local vote-preview-history-delivery/latest.zip contains exactly six required files matching current managed/native bytes and source manifest, API 15/version 0.1.0.3. SHA256: 93c701a2ebfdb70d76f8befd7c04a2561eff493a665a58cb3aa37101b887c087 (channel-history-delivery-package-verification.txt; tested source hashes in channel-history-delivery-preview-source-digests.txt). Original-creator ticket discovery while the creator is offline remains unproven: current offline tests use an active member ticket. Remaining settings/mute/privacy/game audit and release are open. Nothing is installed or published. Reconnect discovery is now being implemented from remembered providers, scoped to the channel rather than unrelated friends. A new verifier uses the original signed HistoryOffer and checks recipient, room, signature owner equals provider ID, legal attempt/snapshot bounds, at most eight supported routes and a 4,096-byte input limit. Both codec tests pass (native/channel-history-peer-hint-codec-tests.log). Schema 5 adds bounded opaque original-offer storage: 32 providers per channel, 256 globally, 30-day local receipt-time read validity, future-receipt exclusion, and replacement when routes change. New tests cover bounds, scope/expiry/replacement and schema-4 migration preserving identity and original signed messages. All 76 Core tests pass for this codec/storage foundation in native/channel-history-peer-hint-storage-tests.log, including migration preservation and bounded/expired hint storage. Persistence admission after authenticated fetch, read-time signature revalidation and reconnect use are not yet wired; this foundation must not be treated as completed discovery. The checked delivery preview predates schema 5 and the hint codec. Provider hints are now admitted only after live offer checks, authenticated snapshot fetch and successful uncancelled ingestion. Original signed offers are retained; channel joins load only unexpired hints bound to this node/channel, reverify signatures and provider row keys, apply current blocks, and merge/deduplicate them with ticket addresses on the worker. Idle/startup maintenance prunes expired/future hints. All 77 Core tests pass for this integration (native/channel-history-peer-hint-final-core-tests.log). The real three-peer case closes the creator, learns the remaining provider through an authenticated fetch, closes/reopens the joiner using its persisted identity and reuses the original creator-only ticket; it receives all three exact originals as historical events, with no live replay. Cached forged signatures, wrong rooms/row identities and blocked providers are rejected. This proves reconnect to previously met providers, not discovery by a first-time node with no reachable contact. Settings now disclose up-to-30-day remembered channel contacts; plugin UI build passes without warnings/errors but uses the prior native DLL solely for compilation. All 107 default and 118 optional workspace tests pass for new schema-5 source in native/channel-history-peer-hint-workspace-tests.log. Optimized Windows/Linux builds completed in native/channel-history-peer-hint-optimized-build.log under native/channel-history-peers/. All ten optimized C# binding tests pass, including a returning node reopening its persisted identity and using the original creator-only ticket to retrieve three exact originals from its remembered peer without live replay. Optimized legacy-library interoperability passes; the managed plugin build has zero warnings/errors and includes the new Windows DLL. The checked local vote-preview-history-peers/latest.zip contains exactly six current build files, API 15/version 0.1.0.3; SHA256 c740633baa5cc3d697d0c337077036fe4f062b99eb8fdb10572f6e41131c07be. The Windows DLL passes the isolated Wine ABI smoke, including signed metadata, exact saved history and acknowledged local clear (native/channel-history-peer-hint-wine-smoke.log).
